Preventing HMPV 🛡️:

1️⃣ Wash your hands 🧼 for 20 sec/use hand sanitizer

2️⃣ Stay away from infected individuals 🤧

3️⃣ Disinfect surfaces 💨 and wear masks in crowded areas

4️⃣ Hydrate 💦, rest, and treat symptoms as needed https://t.co/Gk
